Automated flag on number '1' is a false positive; it comes from the URL/section reference and the 52% (37/71) figures are supported by the citation quote.
Automated flag on '2024' is a false positive; the Breakthrough Therapy designation date '07 Aug 2024' is supported by the basis citation, and year labels for designations are non-substantive.

The detail claims the application was 'reviewed through the Real-Time Oncology Review (RTOR) program' but the only citation supports the December 16, 2024 RTOR submission date, not that RTOR review occurred as stated.
